items.title: Is AI's 'capex tsunami' the catalyst for the next big credit boom?
items.summary: The debt accrued to finance AI data center buildouts continues to soar higher, PIMCO characterizing the fixed income market as suffering from "indigestion" because of this. Morning Brief Host Jake Conley is joined by ProShares global investment strategist Simeon Hyman and Washington Crossing Advisors senior portfolio manager Chad Morganlander to discuss what this rise in AI capex represents for these companies and their relationships to the credit market.

items.title: Can High Gate Fidelity Justify Buying Rigetti Stock Today?
items.summary: Buying the stock today means paying for an engineering roadmap that runs years out, not for the hardware revenue the company books now.

items.title: 3 Stocks Under $50 We Think Twice About
items.summary: Stocks trading between $10 and $50 can be particularly interesting as they frequently represent businesses that have survived their early challenges. However, investors should remain vigilant as some may still have unproven business models, leaving them vulnerable to the ebbs and flows of the broader market.

items.title: Mizuho is bullish on Broadcom ahead of Sept. 2 earnings, citing 30-quarter streak
items.summary: Klein's bullish thesis rests on a convergence of deeply negative sentiment, a near-unbroken historical earnings track record, and an expectation that CEO Hock Tan will directly confront the dominant bear narrative on the call. Broadcom is the most direct publicly traded expression of the custom ASIC AI chip debate — the market's current verdict on whether Google's in-house chip development will erode AVGO's hyperscaler revenue is weighing visibly on the stock.
